Circuit Board.description: An overclocked, neon-wired circuit board Aiko modded herself. Runs dangerously hot.

Servo Motor.description: A servo motor 'borrowed' from a service drone. Still humming from its last job.

Nano-Fiber.description: Smuggled nano-fiber spool. Lightweight, flexible, and definitely illegal.

Power Cell.description: A hotwired power cell. Charges fast, discharges faster. Sparks when shaken.

Scrap Metal.description: Scavenged scrap metal—bent, dented, slightly questionable, but usable.

Sensor Array.description: A ghost-sensor array with the serial numbers filed off. Detects things it probably shouldn't.

AI Chip.description: An unregistered AI chip from banned research. It whispers when you hold it close.

Neural Core.description: A prototype neural core—illegally grown, faintly twitching, deeply unsettling.

Energy Core.description: A fractured energy core fragment. Too powerful for legal sale.

Thruster Core.description: A stolen mini anti-grav thruster core ripped from a courier drone mid-flight.

Weapon System.description: An experimental weapon module. Powerful, unstable, eyebrow-removal risk high.

Metal Plating.description: Black-market armor plating coated in reflective nano-resin.

Rare Component.description: A highly refined rare component Aiko 'acquired' from someone distracted.

Neon Mystery Box.description: A neon loot box containing random crafting materials. Mostly junk, sometimes treasure.

Chaos Crate.description: A premium crate guaranteed to contain at least one rare crafting component. May bite.
